texts.NIV84: The proverbs of Solomon: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish son grief to his mother.
texts.KJV: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.
texts.NKJV:
The proverbs of Solomon:
A wise son makes a glad father,
But a foolish son is the grief of his mother.
texts.DRB: A wise son maketh the father glad: but a foolish son is the sorrow of his mother.

texts.NIV84: Ill-gotten treasures are of no value, but righteousness delivers from death.
texts.KJV: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivereth from death.
texts.NKJV:
Treasures of wickedness profit nothing,
But righteousness delivers from death.
texts.DRB: Treasures of wickedness shall profit nothing: but justice shall deliver from death.

texts.NIV84: The LORD does not let the righteous go hungry but he thwarts the craving of the wicked.
texts.KJV: The Lord will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked.
texts.NKJV:
The Lord will not allow the righteous soul to famish,
But He casts away the desire of the wicked.
texts.DRB: The Lord will not afflict the soul of the just with famine, and he will disappoint the deceitful practices of the wicked.

texts.NIV84: Lazy hands make a man poor, but diligent hands bring wealth.
texts.KJV: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.
texts.NKJV:
He who has a slack hand becomes poor,
But the hand of the diligent makes rich.
texts.DRB: The slothful hand hath wrought poverty: but the hand of the industrious getteth riches. He that trusteth to lies feedeth the winds: and the same runneth after birds that fly away.

texts.NIV84: He who gathers crops in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during harvest is a disgraceful son.
texts.KJV: He that gathereth in summer is a wise son: but he that sleepeth in harvest is a son that causeth shame.
texts.NKJV:
He who gathers in summer is a wise son;
He who sleeps in harvest is a son who causes shame.
texts.DRB: He that gathered in the harvest is a wise son: but he that snorteth in the summer, is the son of confusion.

texts.NIV84: Blessings crown the head of the righteous, but violence overwhelms the mouth of the wicked.
texts.KJV: Blessings are upon the head of the just: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
texts.NKJV:
Blessings are on the head of the righteous,
But violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
texts.DRB: The blessing of the Lord is upon the head of the just: but iniquity covereth the mouth of the wicked.

texts.NIV84: The memory of the righteous will be a blessing, but the name of the wicked will rot.
texts.KJV: The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.
texts.NKJV:
The memory of the righteous is blessed,
But the name of the wicked will rot.
texts.DRB: The memory of the just is with praises: and the name of the wicked shall rot.

texts.NIV84: The wise in heart accept commands, but a chattering fool comes to ruin.
texts.KJV: The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.
texts.NKJV:
The wise in heart will receive commands,
But a prating fool will fall.
texts.DRB: The wise of heart receiveth precepts: a fool is beaten with lips.

texts.NIV84: The man of integrity walks securely, but he who takes crooked paths will be found out.
texts.KJV: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
texts.NKJV:
He who walks with integrity walks securely,
But he who perverts his ways will become known.
texts.DRB: He that walketh sincerely, walketh confidently: but he that perverteth his ways, shall be manifest.

texts.NIV84: He who winks maliciously causes grief, and a chattering fool comes to ruin.
texts.KJV: He that winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.
texts.NKJV:
He who winks with the eye causes trouble,
But a prating fool will fall.
texts.DRB: He that winketh with the eye shall cause sorrow: and the foolish in lips shall be beaten.

texts.NIV84: The mouth of the righteous is a fountain of life, but violence overwhelms the mouth of the wicked.
texts.KJV: The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life: but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.
texts.NKJV:
The mouth of the righteous is a well of life,
But violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
texts.DRB: The mouth of the just is a vein of life: and the mouth of the wicked covereth iniquity.

texts.NIV84: Hatred stirs up dissension, but love covers over all wrongs.
texts.KJV: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.
texts.NKJV:
Hatred stirs up strife,
But love covers all sins.
texts.DRB: Hatred stirreth up strifes: and charity covereth all sins.

texts.NIV84: Wisdom is found on the lips of the discerning, but a rod is for the back of him who lacks judgment.
texts.KJV: In the lips of him that hath understanding wisdom is found: but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.
texts.NKJV:
Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has understanding,
But a rod is for the back of him who is devoid of understanding.
texts.DRB: In the lips of the wise is wisdom found: and a rod on the back of him that wanteth sense.

texts.NIV84: Wise men store up knowledge, but the mouth of a fool invites ruin.
texts.KJV: Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.
texts.NKJV:
Wise people store up knowledge,
But the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.
texts.DRB: Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the fool is next to confusion.

texts.NIV84: The wealth of the rich is their fortified city, but poverty is the ruin of the poor.
texts.KJV: The rich man's wealth is his strong city: the destruction of the poor is their poverty.
texts.NKJV:
The rich man’s wealth is his strong city;
The destruction of the poor is their poverty.
texts.DRB: The substance of a rich man is the city of his strength: the fear of the poor is their poverty.

texts.NIV84: The wages of the righteous bring them life, but the income of the wicked brings them punishment.
texts.KJV: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.
texts.NKJV:
The labor of the righteous leads to life,
The wages of the wicked to sin.
texts.DRB: The work of the just is unto life: but the fruit of the wicked, unto sin.

texts.NIV84: He who heeds discipline shows the way to life, but whoever ignores correction leads others astray.
texts.KJV: He is in the way of life that keepeth instruction: but he that refuseth reproof erreth.
texts.NKJV:
He who keeps instruction is in the way of life,
But he who refuses correction goes astray.
texts.DRB: The way of life, to him that observeth correction: but he that forsaketh reproofs goeth astray.

texts.NIV84: He who conceals his hatred has lying lips, and whoever spreads slander is a fool.
texts.KJV: He that hideth hatred with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.
texts.NKJV:
Whoever hides hatred has lying lips,
And whoever spreads slander is a fool.
texts.DRB: Lying lips hide hatred: he that uttereth reproach is foolish.

texts.NIV84: When words are many, sin is not absent, but he who holds his tongue is wise.
texts.KJV: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refraineth his lips is wise.
texts.NKJV:
In the multitude of words sin is not lacking,
But he who restrains his lips is wise.
texts.DRB: In the multitude of words there shall not want sin: but he that refraineth his lips is most wise.

texts.NIV84: The tongue of the righteous is choice silver, but the heart of the wicked is of little value.
texts.KJV: The tongue of the just is as choice silver: the heart of the wicked is little worth.
texts.NKJV:
The tongue of the righteous is choice silver;
The heart of the wicked is worth little.
texts.DRB: The tongue of the just is as choice silver: but the heart of the wicked is nothing worth.

texts.NIV84: The lips of the righteous nourish many, but fools die for lack of judgment.
texts.KJV: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.
texts.NKJV:
The lips of the righteous feed many,
But fools die for lack of wisdom.
texts.DRB: The lips of the just teach many: but they that are ignorant, shall die in the want of understanding.

texts.NIV84: The blessing of the LORD brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.
texts.KJV: The blessing of the Lord, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.
texts.NKJV:
The blessing of the Lord makes one rich,
And He adds no sorrow with it.
texts.DRB: The blessing of the Lord maketh men rich: neither shall affliction be joined to them.

blocks.title: A Man of Understanding Has Wisdom

texts.NIV84: A fool finds pleasure in evil conduct, but a man of understanding delights in wisdom.
texts.KJV: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom.
texts.NKJV:
To do evil is like sport to a fool,
But a man of understanding has wisdom.
texts.DRB: A fool worketh mischief as it were for sport: but wisdom is prudence to a man.

texts.NIV84: What the wicked dreads will overtake him; what the righteous desire will be granted.
texts.KJV: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.
texts.NKJV:
The fear of the wicked will come upon him,
And the desire of the righteous will be granted.
texts.DRB: That which the wicked feareth, shall come upon him: to the just their desire shall be given.

texts.NIV84: When the storm has swept by, the wicked are gone, but the righteous stand firm forever.
texts.KJV: As the whirlwind passeth, so is the wicked no more: but the righteous is an everlasting foundation.
texts.NKJV:
When the whirlwind passes by, the wicked is no more,
But the righteous has an everlasting foundation.
texts.DRB: As a tempest that passeth, so the wicked shall be no more: but the just is as an everlasting foundation.

texts.NIV84: As vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes, so is a sluggard to those who send him.
texts.KJV: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to them that send him.
texts.NKJV:
As vinegar to the teeth and smoke to the eyes,
So is the lazy man to those who send him.
texts.DRB: As vinegar to the teeth, and smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to them that sent him.

blocks.title: The Mouth of the Righteous Brings Wisdom

texts.NIV84: The fear of the LORD adds length to life, but the years of the wicked are cut short.
texts.KJV: The fear of the Lord prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
texts.NKJV:
The fear of the Lord prolongs days,
But the years of the wicked will be shortened.
texts.DRB: The fear of the Lord shall prolong days: and the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

texts.NIV84: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hopes of the wicked come to nothing.
texts.KJV: The hope of the righteous shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.
texts.NKJV:
The hope of the righteous will be gladness,
But the expectation of the wicked will perish.
texts.DRB: The expectation of the just is joy; but the hope of the wicked shall perish.

texts.NIV84: The way of the LORD is a refuge for the righteous, but it is the ruin of those who do evil.
texts.KJV: The way of the Lord is strength to the upright: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
texts.NKJV:
The way of the Lord is strength for the upright,
But destruction will come to the workers of iniquity.
texts.DRB: The strength of the upright is the way of the Lord: and fear to them that work evil.

texts.NIV84: The righteous will never be uprooted, but the wicked will not remain in the land.
texts.KJV: The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.
texts.NKJV:
The righteous will never be removed,
But the wicked will not inhabit the earth.
texts.DRB: The just shall never be moved: but the wicked shall not dwell on the earth.

texts.NIV84: The mouth of the righteous brings forth wisdom, but a perverse tongue will be cut out.
texts.KJV: The mouth of the just bringeth forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.
texts.NKJV:
The mouth of the righteous brings forth wisdom,
But the perverse tongue will be cut out.
texts.DRB: The mouth of the just shall bring forth wisdom: the tongue of the perverse shall perish.

texts.NIV84: The lips of the righteous know what is fitting, but the mouth of the wicked only what is perverse.
texts.KJV: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked speaketh frowardness.
texts.NKJV:
The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable,
But the mouth of the wicked what is perverse.
texts.DRB: The lips of the just consider what is acceptable: and the mouth of the wicked uttereth perverse things.
